title: 楼上的红星  (The Red Star Upstairs)

segments.t: Late afternoon shadows stretch across the stone fountain in the courtyard. Hao eats a slice of honey cake while spreading the four joined map cards on a round table, with Chen and Qing looking over his shoulder. Listen first.
这莓果杏仁蛋糕真好吃！不过你们看这张拼好的地图……
四张水彩卡片拼成了客栈的院子，中间还有喷泉呢！
志豪，地图右上角画着一颗红星星，指着木头阳台吗？
没错，制图员教授画的红星星，就在二楼栏杆正中间！
可二楼栏杆上面空空的，除了木板什么都没有呀。
老陈，您抬头仔细看栏杆下面那块阴影里！
天哪，真的有个黑乎乎的圆铁环固定在木板上面！
那是用来挂旧黄铜灯笼的钩子吗？
对！地图教授肯定在那儿藏了给周经理姑姑的礼物！
我这就去搬高梯子——真想不到秘密一直在我们头顶上！
等周经理戴着老花镜出来看见，肯定会吓一大跳！
走吧，去二楼阳台，我们一起把三十年前的礼物取下来！
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
这莓果杏仁蛋糕真好吃！不过你们看这张拼好的地图……
'This berry-and-almond cake is truly delicious! But look at this pieced-together map...' "Pin hao" literally links "piece together" with "good / complete", showing the map cards are finally united.
四张水彩卡片拼成了客栈的院子，中间还有喷泉呢！

'The four watercolour cards piece together into the inn's courtyard, and there is even the fountain in the middle!' "Pin cheng" literally joins "piece" with "become", revealing the image, while "shuicai" literally means "watercolour".
志豪，地图右上角画着一颗红星星，指着木头阳台吗？

'Hao, a red star is drawn in the top right corner of the map; is it pointing at the wooden balcony?' "Youshangjiao" literally literally names the "right-up-corner", and "mutou" simply describes solid wood.
没错，制图员教授画的红星星，就在二楼栏杆正中间！

'Exactly, the red star drawn by the mapmaker professor is right in the dead centre of the second-floor railing!' "Zheng zhongjian" literally adds "straight / exact" before "middle" for a precise dead-centre fix.
可二楼栏杆上面空空的，除了木板什么都没有呀。

'But the top of the second-floor railing is completely empty; apart from wooden planks, there is absolutely nothing.' Doubling "kong" literally literally paints a vivid "empty-empty" scene, and "chule... shenme dou meiyou" literally sets up "apart from... absolutely nothing".
老陈，您抬头仔细看栏杆下面那块阴影里！

'Chen, raise your head and look carefully into that patch of shadow right beneath the railing!' "Tai tou" literally literally asks Chen to "lift his head", and "yinying" literally literally names the dark shadow cast by the balcony.
天哪，真的有个黑乎乎的圆铁环固定在木板上面！

'Good heavens, there really is a pitch-black round iron ring secured onto the wooden planks!' "Heihuhu" literally uses the "huhu" suffix to literally describe something dimly and messily "pitch-black".
那是用来挂旧黄铜灯笼的钩子吗？
'Is that a hook used for hanging an old brass lantern?' "Yonglai" literally means "used for", introducing the purpose of the hook, and "denglong" literally names a traditional lantern.
对！地图教授肯定在那儿藏了给周经理姑姑的礼物！
'Right! The mapmaker professor definitely hid a gift for Manager Zhou's aunt up there!' "Kending" literally literally expresses absolute certainty, and "cang" is the action of hiding something away.
我这就去搬高梯子——真想不到秘密一直在我们头顶上！

'I will go fetch the tall ladder right now—truly unexpected that the secret was above our heads the whole time!' "Xiang bu dao" literally wraps "think" in negative potential, meaning "unable to predict / unexpected".
等周经理戴着老花镜出来看见，肯定会吓一大跳！

'When Manager Zhou comes out wearing his reading glasses and sees it, he will definitely jump in massive surprise!' "Xia yi da tiao" literally playfully stretches "jump from a scare" with "da" for a huge startle.
走吧，去二楼阳台，我们一起把三十年前的礼物取下来！
'Let us go, off to the second-floor balcony; together we will take down the thirty-year-old gift!' "Qu xialai" literally pairs "retrieve / fetch" with the downward motion "down-come".
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.
这莓果杏仁蛋糕真好吃！不过你们看这张拼好的地图……
四张水彩卡片拼成了客栈的院子，中间还有喷泉呢！
志豪，地图右上角画着一颗红星星，指着木头阳台吗？
没错，制图员教授画的红星星，就在二楼栏杆正中间！
可二楼栏杆上面空空的，除了木板什么都没有呀。
老陈，您抬头仔细看栏杆下面那块阴影里！
天哪，真的有个黑乎乎的圆铁环固定在木板上面！
那是用来挂旧黄铜灯笼的钩子吗？
对！地图教授肯定在那儿藏了给周经理姑姑的礼物！
我这就去搬高梯子——真想不到秘密一直在我们头顶上！
等周经理戴着老花镜出来看见，肯定会吓一大跳！
走吧，去二楼阳台，我们一起把三十年前的礼物取下来！
Chen runs for the heavy ladder while Hao and Qing head up the wooden stairs. The final secret waits in the shadows! End of Episode 3—see you in Episode 4!
